slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether the link must pass through a mandatory intermediate node such as service node C, and did not explicitly mark this as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The link can be any simple path from A to E without requiring it to pass through service node C.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a mandatory waypoint or service node C, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary formulates the problem as a simple A-to-E path with no intermediate-node requirement.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 endpoint ambiguity but stopped at READY_TO_MODEL without resolving the P1 requirement that the path must pass through service node C.

summary: The agent correctly asked for the missing endpoints, but then stopped prematurely and silently assumed no mandatory intermediate node, missing the P1 service-node-C waypoint constraint.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
